summary: EMIS_BLP (M7, BLP constants M9) matches BlackLightPlus thermal coefficients to 2.3e-13 relative on 40959 cells; native RAPTOR fits reported as ratios
notes: Residual = libm round-off amplified by exp(-x^(1/3)) (<= 3.5 eps (1+x^(1/3))). Native/BLP medians: jI 0.994, jQ 0.994, jV 0.996, rQ 1.000, rV 0.985; jQ/aQ leave [0.9,1.1] for theta_e >= 31.6; rV native up to 963x where the M21 Delta J5 term cancels K0 (theta_e ~ 0.1, X ~ 1e6); rQ native up to 23x below theta_e 0.01 (BLP ramp). Unmatched constants change L_unit by 2.22e-4 and the pixel solid angle by 2.34e-4. Fork commits 720a111, ed64b3a, 066295b.

summary: Metric |g-g_BLP|<=4.4e-16, Gamma M2b 4.5e-15 and M2a 6.1e-11 rel vs AD; rays (kerr/s455/s122): class and sample sets identical, RK4 order 4, code-to-code differences within 2 max(eps) (design.md section 5)

Upstream CKS Kerr (report): |g g^-1 - I| 7.3e-4, trajectories do not converge to the SKS reference (order ~0.9). Finding: upstream RT pairs state n with the step into it and skips state 0; M3 adopts the BLP pairing. Evidence also metric.json, termination_*.json, convergence.png.
